sc.text:
*{name}*
> A modular, plugin-based WhatsApp bot built on @zavedyaid/baileys, with hot-reload and no build step, interactive messages (lists, catalogs, promos, forwards from channels), the api.zavedya.id router, plus built-in limit, level and EXP systems.

> Features?
> Plenty, such as
> Play, Tiktok, swgc, and more

> Author
> - ZavedyaID ( OWNER / DEVELOPER)
> - RullzFuqi ( Base / Co-developer )
> - ZavedyaApi ( Router for all bot features )

Note: This script still has only a few features, so keep supporting us! If you find a bug, please report it to us!!!

*Don't forget to leave a star!*
{repo}

› *{p}backup* — create & send a backup (database + config)
› *{p}backup full* — whole project + WhatsApp session (no node_modules / .npm)
› *{p}backup list* — saved backups
› *{p}backup get <no|name>* — send a saved backup
